content.value_statement: Hardware teams need structured compliance drafts without inventing missing product facts. This guide helps an assistant draft CE, RoHS, and REACH documents for qualified review.
actual_capabilities: Guides collection of product, manufacturer, authorized representative, directive, standards, and restricted substance details.
Guides drafting of CE Declaration of Conformity fields using supplied product information.
Guides drafting of RoHS statements referencing Directive 2011/65/EU and amendment 2015/863/EU.
Guides drafting of REACH SVHC declarations addressing Article 33 supplier communication.
Directs the assistant to mark missing information as [PLACEHOLDER] instead of guessing.
limitations: The package contains only a public guide; original scripts, extension source, and template assets are not included.
The mentioned date-stamped regulatory reference file is absent, so current regulatory references require independent verification.
Drafts do not establish compliance, replace testing, or provide legal verification.
The guide does not cover machinery, medical device, or radio equipment specifics.

use_cases.title: Prepare an initial documentation package
use_cases.description: Organize supplied product facts into CE, RoHS, and REACH drafts for an initial compliance review.

use_cases.title: Assemble supplier declarations
use_cases.description: Draft RoHS and REACH supplier paperwork while identifying missing substance information.

use_cases.title: Refresh manufacturer documentation
use_cases.description: Update draft declarations after product or standards changes, retaining placeholders for details that still require verification.

prompt_templates.title: Start a compliance intake
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare EU compliance drafts for [product and model]. Ask for missing manufacturer, directive, standards, representative, and substance information before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a CE declaration
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a CE Declaration of Conformity for [product], manufactured by [legal name]. Use only [confirmed directives] and [verified standards]. Mark unknowns [PLACEHOLDER].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare one document from confirmed inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare substance declarations
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [supplier evidence], draft separate RoHS and REACH SVHC statements for [product]. Identify missing substance data. Do not assert compliance without supporting evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: organize substance evidence for review.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh a documentation package
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [existing drafts] against [updated product details] and [verified regulatory references]. Revise CE, RoHS, and REACH drafts. List unresolved facts for qualified review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise multiple documents after a product change.

output_examples.input: Draft a CE declaration for SmartHub X1 by NexGen Tech using confirmed LVD 2014/35/EU and EMC 2014/30/EU references.
output: Product: SmartHub X1. Manufacturer: NexGen Tech.
Manufacturer address, applicable standards, signatory, place, and date: [PLACEHOLDER].
Status: Draft requiring qualified review before signature or use.

output_examples.input: Prepare RoHS and REACH drafts for SmartHub X1. Supplier substance evidence is not yet available.
output: Draft RoHS Statement: SmartHub X1. References: 2011/65/EU as amended by 2015/863/EU.
Supporting substance evidence and compliance conclusion: [PLACEHOLDER].
Draft REACH SVHC Declaration: Article 33 communication under Regulation 1907/2006.
Candidate List date, substance information, and communication details: [PLACEHOLDER].
Status: Evidence required before any compliance assertion.

best_practices: Provide verified manufacturer, product, directive, standards, and substance details before requesting a final draft.
Check regulatory references against current official EU sources and retain dated supporting evidence.
Have a qualified compliance professional review every draft and resolve placeholders before signature or distribution.
anti_patterns: Treating generated declarations as certification or proof of compliance.
Guessing applicable directives, standards, or substance status to eliminate placeholders.
Assuming the missing templates or regulatory reference file are included in this package.

faq.question: Which documents can this guide help draft?
faq.answer: It guides drafting of a CE Declaration of Conformity, a RoHS statement, and a REACH SVHC declaration.

faq.question: Does it certify my hardware?
faq.answer: No. It provides drafting guidance and does not perform testing or verify legal compliance.

faq.question: What happens when information is missing?
faq.answer: The guide directs the assistant to use [PLACEHOLDER] rather than invent missing details.

faq.question: Are scripts and ready-made template files included?
faq.answer: No. This package contains only SKILL.md, which states that original scripts, extension source, and templates are excluded.

faq.question: Are the regulatory references automatically current?
faq.answer: No. The mentioned date-stamped reference file is absent. Verify references against current official EU sources.

faq.question: Can it support a manufacturer outside the EU?
faq.answer: It includes authorized representative fields. A qualified professional must determine the obligations that apply to your product and market role.
